## Summary

Describe what this pull request changes and why.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change addressing an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change adding functionality)
- [ ] Security or reliability hardening
- [ ] Documentation or tests

## Verification Checklist

- [ ] `npm run typecheck` passes cleanly
- [ ] `npm test` passes cleanly
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds
- [ ] `npm run seo:audit` passes (if routes, templates, or metadata changed)
- [ ] No real API keys, `.env` values, or personal resume PII are included in committed files
